blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE
blocks.zh: 一般性的深层假象探测仍然具有挑战性,因为伪造文物在操纵类型上差别很大,而且往往将不同的空间和时间不一致结合起来。 现有参数效率高的适应方法通常依靠单一的共享代表,使其容易出现操纵性特定偏见,并将转让限制在隐形伪造行为。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出 " 空间-时空专家混合 " (Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Expertion,MoSTE),这是一个适应性框架,能够有条件地使法医陈述专业化。 MoSTE没有强迫一个适配器模拟所有伪造模式,而是通过一个不受监督的象征级通路机制,将适应分解为平行的时空专家集合并动态地向最相关的专家传递信号. 这使得专家可以自然地专门从事互补的伪造提示,而不需要明确的操纵标签或多阶段培训,同时有效地将表现从CLIP转移到视频领域. 跨数据集和跨操纵基准的广泛实验表明,科技部在平均概括方面设定了一个新的技术水平,同时保持了不同操纵家庭的强效性能。 对专家路线和注意力行为的其他分析揭示出专家多样性的出现,表明科技部学习了互补的斯皮提欧-时空法医学特征. 代码见https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation [ 49 , 44 , 41 , 7 , 48 ] has reached unprecedented levels of realism, driven by remarkably rapid advancements in generative models including Stable Diffusion [ 44 ] , Sora [ 2 ] , Flux [ 26 ] , and WanVideo [ 48 ] . While such advancements allow for new creative prospects in use cases related to entertainment and marketing, they thrust upon us the danger of deepfakes - generated videos portraying individuals in scenarios that never occurred. Deepfakes pose an imminent security threat, and have already been weaponized for manipulation, disinformation, and fraud [ 34 , 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频生成[49、44、41、7、48] 已经达到了前所未有的现实主义水平,其动力是基因模型的迅速发展,包括稳定扩散[44]、Sora[2]、Flux[26]和WanVideo[48]。 虽然这些进步在娱乐和营销案件中创造了新的创意前景,但它们却给我们带来了深层假象的危险,这些假象是制作的录像,在从未发生的情景中描绘个人。 深层假象构成迫在眉睫的安全威胁,已经为操纵、造谣和欺诈而武器化[34、47]。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Face Swap vs. Face Reenactment generalization on DF40 dataset. We compare MoSTE with CLIP+LP [ 42 ] , LoRA [ 21 ] , UCF [ 56 ] , DFD-FCG [ 20 ] , EFFORT [ 54 ] , and ForAda [ 10 ] . Each point reports video-level AUC averaged over the corresponding manipulation family. MoSTE, shown with a star, achieves the best balance between Face Swap and Face Reenactment performance.
blocks.zh: 图1 : Face Swap vs. Face Reenactment generalization on DF40数据集的Face重现通论. 我们比较MOSTE与CLIP+LP[42],LORA[21],UCF[56],DFD-FCG[20],EFFFT[54],和ForAda[10]. 每个点都报告AUC的视频级别平均比相应的操纵家族. MoSTE以恒星显示,在Face Swap和Face Reenactment的性能上实现了最佳平衡.

blocks.en:
Consequently, deepfake detection has gained high interest and impact in computer vision [ 40 , 43 , 1 , 8 ] . Early approaches leveraged deep learning architectures aimed at discriminating real and fake images and videos, and were able to achieve impressive results in in-dataset evaluation; however, their performance often collapsed in cross-dataset settings, i.e., they lacked generalizability .
Therefore, more recent research aimed at improving generalization by focusing on specific forgery clues, such as frequency domain analysis [ 32 , 40 ] and blending artifacts [ 27 ] . Additional approaches explored the use of synthetic data [ 46 , 61 ] , in order to reduce overfitting to manipulation-specific cues.
We note that existing detectors remain challenged when facing images and videos pertaining to “unseen” generative models, i.e., out of training distribution, as they tend to overfit to specific artifact distributions of their training domains.
blocks.zh:
因此,深层假象探测对计算机视觉[40、43、1、8]产生了很高的兴趣和影响。 早期方法利用了旨在歧视真实和假图像和视频的深层学习架构,并在数据集内评价中取得了令人印象深刻的成果;然而,它们的表现往往在跨数据集环境中崩溃,即缺乏通用性。
因此,更近期的研究旨在通过注重特定的伪造线索,如频率域分析[32,40]和混合文物[27],来改进归纳. 其他办法探讨使用合成数据[46、61],以减少过于适合操纵特定提示。
我们注意到,现有的探测器在面对与“不明”基因模型有关的图像和录像时仍然面临挑战,即由于培训的分发,它们往往过于适合其培训领域的具体文物的分发。

blocks.en: Recently, adapting foundation models has become a promising direction towards more generalizable detection [ 20 , 10 , 54 , 57 , 9 ] , as these models demonstrate inherent zero-shot capabilities. Such parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques for deepfake detection primarily focus on equipping pretrained backbones with forgery priors, leveraging the associated foundational knowledge.
blocks.zh: 最近,调整基础模型已成为更普遍的探测[20、10、54、57、9]的有希望的方向,因为这些模型显示出固有的零射能力。 这种用于深假检测的参数高效微调(PEFT)技术主要侧重于为预先训练过的骨干配备伪造前科,利用相关的基础知识.

blocks.en:
However, such approaches often tend to neglect the inductive bias inherent
to each PEFT technique [ 33 , 35 ] .
Specifically, a model adapted using a fine-tuning strategy may become highly effective at detecting certain manipulation types, while underperforming on others. Such bias limits the robustness of detectors and hinders generalization across diverse and unseen forgery methods.
We illustrate in Fig. 1 how different adaptations yield inconsistent performance in deepfake detection, in particular for Face Swap and Reenactment. We note that Face Swap involves identity replacement, whereas Face Reenactment entails transferring facial expressions from one person to another.
EFFORT [ 54 ] and ForAda [ 10 ] achieve high Area Under the Curve (AUCs) on Face Swap; however, on Face Reenactment, they show similar performance to the base CLIP model. Conversely, methods such as DFD-FCG [ 20 ] significantly improve results on Face Reenactment by considering temporality, whereas demonstrate limited performance on Face Swap, on challenging datasets such as DFDC [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh:
然而,这种处理办法往往忽视了固有的诱导性偏见。
用于每个PEFT技术[33,35].
具体地说,采用微调战略加以调整的模型在发现某些操纵类型时可能变得非常有效,而对其他类型则表现不佳。 这种偏差限制了探测器的稳健性,并阻碍了各种隐形伪造方法的普及。
我们在图1中说明了不同适应如何在深假探测中产生不一致的性能,特别是在Face Swap和Reenactment方面。 我们注意到Face Swap涉及身份替换,而Face Reenactment则涉及将面部表情从一个人转移到另一个人.
EFFFORT [54] 和ForAda [10] 在Face Swap上实现曲线下的高面积(AUCs);然而,在Face Reenactment上,它们表现出与基础CLIP模型相似的性能. 反之,DFD-FCG [20] 等方法通过考虑时间性而大大改进了Face Reactment上的结果,同时在Face Swap上显示在像DFDC[12]这样的具有挑战性的数据集上的性能有限.

blocks.en:
We note that it is imperative to
consider the bias limits , in order to ensure generalizability.
Therefore, we deviate from a
single representation by enforcing independent learning of different forgery traces and modeling thereof.
Specifically, we decompose adaptation into specialized spatial and temporal experts and allow tokens to dynamically select the most relevant experts during training. This transforms adaptation from a fixed global transformation into an input-dependent process.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到必须:
考虑偏见限制,以确保普遍性。
因此,我们偏离
通过对不同的伪造痕迹进行独立学习并制作模型,实现单一代表。
具体地说,我们把适应分解成专门的空间和时间专家,并允许象征性地在培训期间动态地挑选最相关的专家。 这把适应从固定的全球转型转变为依赖投入的进程。

blocks.en: We propose a Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), where we insert an adapter across transformer layers of a frozen CLIP-ViT-L/14 backbone. MoSTE disentangles adaptation into spatial and temporal expert pools, while token-level routing dynamically assigns tokens to the most relevant experts. This enables specialization across both artifact nature and artifact diversity without explicit manipulation labels. This approach effectively resolves the imbalance in manipulation sensitivity and establishes a highly generalizable detection framework. Our contributions include the following.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个Spatio-Temporal Experient(MoSTE)的混合体,在其中插入一个适配器,跨越冷冻的CLIP-ViT-L/14主干线的变压器层. MoSTE将适应分解为空间和时间专家人才库,而象征级的路由则动态地向最相关的专家分配符号. 这样就能够在没有明确操纵标签的情况下,在文物性质和文物多样性方面实现专业化。 这种方法有效地解决了操纵敏感度的不平衡,建立了非常普遍的检测框架. 我们的贡献包括:

blocks.en:
• We introduce MoSTE, a novel single-stage PEFT framework for video deepfake detection that performs spatio-temporal adaptation through token-level expert routing . Unlike previous approaches that learn a single shared representation per manipulation type, MoSTE allows unsupervised specialization across diverse forgery traces without explicit guidance. • We conduct extensive experiments, comparing MoSTE to recent SOTA on datasets such as Celeb-DF-v3 [ 29 ] and DF40 [ 55 ] under a set of protocols. Our results suggest that MoSTE is endowed with generalizability , as opposed to SOTA models. • We evaluate MoSTE
entailing large-scale training using the DF40 Face Swap and Face Reenactment subsets, in order to assess the scalability of our proposed adaptation architecture and its generalization capability.
blocks.zh:
• 支助 我们介绍MoSTE, 一个用于视频深假检测的新单阶段PEFT框架, 与以往学习每个操纵类型单一共享表示的方法不同的是,科技部允许在没有明确指导的情况下,在各种伪造痕迹之间实现不受监督的专业化。 我们进行了广泛的实验,将MOSTE与一套协议下Celeb-DF-v3[29]和DF40[55]等数据集的SOTA进行比较. 我们的结果表明,与SOTA模型相比,科技部具有通用性。 我们评价科技部
需要使用DF40 Face Swap和Face Reenactment子集进行大规模培训,以评估我们拟议的适应结构的可扩展性及其通用能力。

Unlike previous approaches that learn a single shared representation per manipulation type, MoSTE allows unsupervised specialization across diverse forgery traces without explicit guidance.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Generalizable Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 一般性的深假检测

blocks.en:
Limited generalization capacity of deepfake detection stems from the tendency of models to capture manipulation-specific cues rather than intrinsic forensic traces. Towards mitigating this challenge, a prominent research direction focused on learning universal forgery artifacts, including frequency-domain inconsistencies [ 32 , 31 , 40 ] , blending artifacts [ 27 , 10 , 37 ] , and facial attribute anomalies [ 19 , 18 ] . Another widely explored approach leveraged blending data [ 27 , 46 , 61 ] by simulating common forgery inconsistencies, aimed at encouraging models to learn generalized forgery features. Subsequent studies [ 5 , 30 ] have proposed training strategies that combine handcrafted pseudo-fake samples and deepfake data from FaceForensics++ (FF++) dataset.
Under the same blending-data paradigm, several works [ 36 , 3 , 57 ] extended pseudo-fake generation to the video domain by simulating common temporal artifacts, like temporal landmark drifting.
blocks.zh:
深层假象探测的有限通用能力源于模型捕捉操纵特定提示而不是内在法证痕迹的倾向. 为了减轻这一挑战,一项突出的研究方向侧重于学习普遍的伪造文物,包括频率域不一致[32、31、40]、混合文物[27、10、37]和面部特征异常[19、18]。 另一种广泛探讨的方法利用混合数据[27、46、61],模拟常见的伪造不一致之处,目的是鼓励模型学习通用的伪造特征。 随后的研究[5,30]提出了将手工制作的伪假样本与FaceForensics++(FF++)数据集的深假数据相结合的培训策略.
在同一混合数据范式下,多部作品[36,3,57]通过模拟常见的时空文物,如时空地标漂移,将伪假生成扩展到视频领域.

blocks.en: Tackling generalizability , research works [ 17 , 23 , 59 ] advanced deepfake detection into the spatio-temporal domain by explicitly modeling temporal dynamics to capture artifacts such as temporal inconsistency, and unnatural motion. These methods employ diverse strategies, including 3D convolutional backbones [ 62 ] , temporal encoding schemes [ 51 ] , spatial–temporal optimization [ 50 ] , and latent style-flow cues [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 研究课题[17,23,59]通过明确模拟时间动态来捕捉时间不一致,以及非自然运动等文物,将深假探测推进到时空领域. 这些方法采用不同的策略,包括3D旋律骨干[62],时间编码方案[51],空间-时空优化[50],潜在风格流提示[6].

blocks.en: Deviating from the aforementioned approaches, we assume that each manipulation category exhibits distinct forgery artifacts, and therefore a single adaptation strategy is insufficient. To address this, we propose a novel adapter architecture capable of dynamically adapting to the diverse landscape of forensic traces.
blocks.zh: 与上述办法不同,我们假设,每个操纵类别都显示不同的伪造文物,因此,单一的适应战略是不够的。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出一个新的适配器架构,能够动态地适应法医痕迹的多样性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Model Adaptation for Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 深假检测基础模型改造

blocks.en: Foundation vision-language models such as CLIP [ 42 ] have strong transfer ability, motivating recent CLIP-based deepfake detectors [ 10 , 54 , 57 , 20 , 52 ] . These methods preserve pretrained representations while learning forensic cues [ 54 ] : ForensicsAdapter [ 10 ] learns blending-aware attention biases, Yan et al. [ 57 ] add spatial-temporal modules using synthetic videos, DFD-FCG [ 20 ] uses a side decoder for intermediate spatial-temporal cues, and EFFORT [ 54 ] adapts LoRA [ 21 ] while retaining principal components. However, these PEFT strategies remain fixed across manipulation types and may introduce their own inductive bias [ 33 ] , limiting generalization to out-of-training manipulations. MoSTE instead routes tokens through specialized spatial and temporal expert pools.
blocks.zh: CLIP[42]等基础视觉语言模型具有强大的传导能力,激发了最近基于CLIP的深假探测器[10,54,57,20,52]. 这些方法在学习法证提示时保留了事先经过训练的陈述 [54]: 法医Adapter [10] 学习混合意识的注意力偏差, 颜等. [57] 使用合成视频添加时空模块,DFD-FCG[20]对中间时空提示使用侧解码器,EFFORT[54]在保留主元件的同时调整LORA[21]. 然而,这些PEFT战略仍然固定在各种操纵类型之间,并可能引入自己的诱导性偏差[33],将通用性限制在培训外的操纵. 科技部转而通过专门的空间和时间专家人才库传送信使。

blocks.en: 2.3 Mixture of Experts in Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 深假检测专家的混合

blocks.en:
The Mixture of Experts (MoE) paradigm has recently emerged in multimedia forensics as an effective mechanism to improve cross-domain generalization. MoE-FFD [ 24 ] integrates LoRA and Adapter layers as distinct experts within Vision Transformers (ViT) to extract complementary global and local forgery cues. DevFD [ 60 ] extends this to continual learning by adding orthogonal LoRA experts for emerging manipulation types. Forensic-MoE [ 15 ] broadens the scope to universal synthetic image detection by assigning experts explicitly to GAN and Diffusion generative domains.
Despite their promise, these approaches share two fundamental limitations. First, they operate at the frame level [ 24 , 60 , 15 ] , entirely discarding temporal artifacts. Second, they rely on explicit domain supervision or multi-stage training to guide expert specialization [ 60 , 15 ] . In contrast, MoSTE addresses both limitations through a single-stage spatio-temporal framework with an unsupervised routing mechanism that autonomously discovers spatial and temporal forgery traces without requiring domain labels or sequential pre-training.
blocks.zh:
最近,在多媒体法证学中出现了专家混合(MoE)范式,作为改进跨域通用的有效机制。 MOE-FFD [24] 将LORA和适配器层整合为Vision Transformers(ViT)中的独特专家,以提取互补的全球和地方伪造提示. DevFD [60] 将此延伸至不断学习,为新出现的操纵类型增加正交LORA专家。 法医-MOE[15]通过明确指派专家到GAN和扩散基因域,将范围扩大到普遍合成图像检测。
尽管这些办法有其承诺,但它们有两项基本限制。 首先,它们运行在帧级[24,60,15],完全抛弃了时空文物. 第二,它们依靠明确的领域监督或多阶段培训来指导专家专业化[60,15]。 相比之下,科技部通过一个单阶段的Spatio-timoral框架来处理这两个限制,其中有一个不受监督的路由机制,它自动发现空间和时间伪造痕迹,而不需要域标签或顺序的预训.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce MoSTE, an adapter to transfer frozen CLIP-ViT image representations to the video deepfake detection domain. The key challenge is that forgery evidence is diverse: some artifacts are spatial and appear within individual frames, while others are temporal and only emerge across frames. Moreover, different manipulation families introduce different traces, e.g., face swaps often produce blending artifacts, whereas reenactment methods may create motion or landmark inconsistencies. A single shared adapter projection has to encode all these cues with the same parameters, which can limit specialization. MoSTE addresses this diversity by replacing the standard adapter bottleneck with a mixture of spatio-temporal experts. Each adapter first projects tokens to a compact bottleneck representation, then routes them to two expert pools: spatial experts process patches within each frame, while temporal experts process the same patch locations across frames. A token-level router selects and weights the most relevant experts, allowing different tokens to rely on different forensic cues without requiring manipulation labels. Fig. 2 illustrates the overall adapter framework. Section 3.2 details the expert design, and Section 3.3 describes routing and load balancing.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了MoSTE,一个适配器,将冷冻的CLIP-ViT图像表示器传输到视频深假检测域. 关键的挑战在于伪造证据多种多样:一些文物是空间性的,出现在单个框架之内,而另一些则是时间性的,只是跨框架出现的. 此外,不同的操纵家族引入了不同的痕迹,例如面额互换往往会产生混合的文物,而重现方法则可能造成运动或标志性的不一致. 单一共享适配器投影必须用相同的参数编码所有这些提示,这可以限制专业化. MoSTE通过将标准适配器瓶颈替换为时空专家的混合物来解决这种多样性. 每个适配器先对一个紧凑的瓶颈表示表示,然后将其引向两个专家库:空间专家在每个框架内处理补丁,而时间专家跨框架处理相同的补丁位置. 一个符号级路由器选择和加权最相关的专家,允许不同的符号依赖不同的法证提示而不需要操纵标签. 图2说明了总体适配器框架。 第3.2节详细介绍了专家的设计,第3.3节介绍了路线和负载平衡。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the MoSTE architecture. MoSTE adapters are inserted into a frozen CLIP-ViT backbone and operate in the adapter bottleneck space. Tokens are routed to independent spatial and temporal expert pools. The selected expert outputs are masked, weighted, fused, and projected back through a residual adapter update.
blocks.zh: 图2:科技部架构概况. MoSTE适配器插入一个冷冻的CLIP-ViT主干线,并在适配器瓶颈空间运行. 托肯是通往独立的空间和时间专家人才库的。 选定的专家产出被掩盖、加权、组合,并通过剩余适配器更新后再预测。

blocks.en: 3.2 Spatio-Temporal Expert Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 空间-时空专家设计

blocks.en: MoSTE builds on the observation that artifacts are both spatially and temporally different. Instead of using a fixed dual-pathway adapter [ 38 , 39 ] , we introduce conditional spatial and temporal expert pools with token-level routing. Each adapter maps the input X i ​ n X_{in} to a bottleneck representation X m ​ i ​ d X_{mid} through a shared down-projection and GELU activation, then processes X m ​ i ​ d X_{mid} with two independent expert pools.
blocks.zh: 科技部基于对文物在空间和时间上都不同的看法。 我们不使用固定的双向适配器[38,39],而是引入有条件的空间和时空专家池,并带有象征性的路由. 每个适配器通过共享下投影和GELU激活,将输入X i n {in} 映射到瓶颈代表X m i d mid},然后用两个独立专家库处理X m i d mid}。

blocks.en: A common failure mode in MoE models is routing collapse , where most tokens are repeatedly assigned to a small subset of experts. This reduces expert diversity and limits the benefit of using an MoE architecture. Standard approaches often prevent this behavior with auxiliary load-balancing losses, but these losses introduce an additional optimization objective that may interfere with the main deepfake detection loss.
blocks.zh: 在MOE模型中一个常见的故障模式是路由崩溃,其中大多数的令牌被反复分配给一个小子集的专家. 这减少了专家的多样性,限制了使用教育部架构的好处。 标准方法经常用辅助负载平衡损失来防止这种行为,但这些损失引入了一个额外的优化目标,可能会干扰主要的深假检测损失.

blocks.en: To avoid this, we follow the auxiliary-loss-free strategy of DeepSeek-V3 [ 11 ] . Each expert e e is assigned an adaptive routing bias b e b_{e} , which is used only when selecting the Top- k k experts for each token: 𝒯 i = Top- ​ k e ​ ( r i , e + b e ) , \mathcal{T}_{i}=\text{Top-}k_{e}(r_{i,e}+b_{e}), (5) where r i , e r_{i,e} is the routing logit between token i i and expert e e , and 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} denotes the selected expert set.
blocks.zh: 为了避免这种情况,我们遵循DeepSeek-V3的辅助无损失策略[11]. 每个e专家被分配到适应性路由偏差b e b_{e},仅在为每个符号选择Top-k k专家时使用: Ti = Top-k e (r i, e + b e ),\ mathcal{T}_{i}=\text{Top-}k_{e}(r_{i, e}+b_{e}), (5) r i, e r_{i, e } 是 order i 和 expert e 之间的路由登录, T i \ mathcal{ T}_{i } 表示选定的专家集。

blocks.en: Importantly, the bias affects only the expert selection step. Once the experts are selected, the routing weights are still computed from the original logits r i , e r_{i,e} , as in Eq. 2 . This preserves the main learning signal while allowing the router to correct imbalanced expert usage.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,这种偏见只影响到专家甄选步骤。 一旦选定了专家,路线权重仍然从原始的logits r i, e r_{i,e )计算,如Eq. 2。 这保留了主学习信号,同时允许路由器纠正不平衡的专家用法.

blocks.en: After each training step, we update the bias according to the observed expert load. Experts that receive too many tokens have their bias decreased, making them less likely to be selected in subsequent steps. Conversely, underused experts have their bias increased, encouraging the router to assign them more tokens. This simple feedback mechanism keeps expert utilization balanced without introducing any auxiliary loss. As shown in Fig. 3 , it maintains well-distributed routing across experts while allowing the model to optimize only the primary detection objective.
blocks.zh: 每个训练步骤后,我们都会根据观察到的专家负荷更新偏差. 接收过多信物的专家的偏好有所降低,因此在以后的步骤中不太可能被选中. 反之,利用不足的专家的偏见增加,鼓励路由器给他们分配更多的代币. 这种简单的反馈机制使专家的利用率保持平衡,而不带来任何附带损失。 如图3所示,它保持分布良好的跨专家路径,同时允许模型仅优化初级检测目标.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We here elaborate on implementation details and evaluation settings,
and proceed to evaluate MoSTE under two deepfake detection protocols, aimed at assessing generalization across datasets and manipulation types. We then conduct an ablation study, in order to quantify the contribution of each MoSTE-component.
blocks.zh:
我们在此阐述执行细节和评价环境,
并着手在两个深假检测协议下评估科技部,目的是评估各种数据集的通用性和操纵类型。 然后,我们进行一项消化研究,以量化科技部每个组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We use CLIP-ViT-L/14 [ 42 ] as a frozen backbone and insert MoSTE adapters into all 24 transformer blocks, optimizing only the adapters, classification head, and learnable temporal embeddings. Each adapter has bottleneck dimension d adapter = 128 d_{\text{adapter}}=128 and separate spatial/temporal expert pools with N = 4 N=4 experts each, Top- k k routing with k = 3 k=3 , and auxiliary-loss-free bias balancing with update speed γ = 10 − 4 \gamma=10^{-4} . We train for 10 epochs on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs using Adam with learning rate 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} , β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and cosine annealing to 10 − 5 10^{-5} with t max = 10 t_{\max}=10 . From each video, we sample 32 frames and feed 8-frame clips with horizontal flip, random rotation, Gaussian blur, and brightness/contrast perturbations.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价设置

blocks.en: We conduct training on the FF++ dataset [ 45 ] under the C23 compression setting. The training split comprises 1,000 real and 4,000 manipulated videos.
blocks.zh: 我们在C23压缩设置下对FF++数据集进行训练[45]. 培训分为1 000个真实视频和4 000个被操纵视频。

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the generalization capability of the proposed approach, we adopt two complementary evaluation protocols, namely Protocol-1 (cross-dataset evaluation) and Protocol-2 (cross-manipulation evaluation within the FF++ domain) that we proceed to elaborate on.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评价拟议办法的一般化能力,我们通过了两个补充评价议定书,即第1号议定书(交叉数据集评价)和第2号议定书(FF++范围内的交叉管理评价),我们着手加以阐述。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Cross-dataset evaluation results under Protocol-1. All methods are trained on FaceForensics++ (FF++) C23 and evaluated across different datasets. Baseline results are taken from [ 54 ] and reported in terms of video-level AUC (%). † indicates inference from official checkpoints. The best result for each dataset is highlighted in bold, and the second-best result is underlined.
blocks.zh: 表1:议定书1下的交叉数据集评价结果。 所有方法都经过FaceForensics+(FF++)培训. C23和不同数据集的评价。 基线结果来自[54],以视频级AUC(%)报告。 • 表示官方检查站的推论。 每个数据集的最佳结果以粗体突出,二最佳结果以粗体突出。

blocks.en: Protocol-1. Cross-Dataset Evaluation. In this setting, models trained on FF++ are evaluated on large-scale deepfake benchmarks without further fine-tuning. Specifically, we consider Celeb-DF v2 (CDF-v2) [ 28 ] , Celeb-DF-v3 (CDF-v3) [ 29 ] , DeepFakeDetection (DFD) [ 14 ] , the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC) dataset [ 12 ] , and its preview version (DFDCP) [ 13 ] . This protocol measures robustness to domain shifts in data distribution, compression artifacts, and manipulation pipelines.
blocks.zh: 第1号议定书。 跨数据集评价. 在这一背景下,经过FF++培训的模型在大规模深假基准上进行评价,而不作进一步的微调. 具体来说,我们认为Celeb-DF v2 (CDF-v2) [28],Celeb-DF-v3 (CDF-v3) [29], Deep Fake Deaction (DFD) [14], Deep Fake Deaction Challenge (DFDC) data set [12],及其预览版 (DFDCP) [13]. 这项协议测量数据分布、压缩文物和操纵管道的域位变化的强度。

blocks.en: Protocol-2. Cross-Manipulation Evaluation. As proposed by Yan et al. [ 54 ] , we further assess generalization to unseen manipulation methods using the recently introduced DF40 dataset [ 55 ] . DF40 is constructed from real samples in CDF and includes deepfakes generated with 40 additional manipulation techniques, including face swaps and reenactment. Protocol-2 evaluates the model’s ability to generalize to a more diverse set of forgery methods.
blocks.zh: 第2号议定书. 交叉管理 评价。 如颜等提议. [54],我们利用最近引进的DF40数据集,进一步评估通用到隐形操纵方法[55]. DF40由CDF中的真实样本构建而成,包括用40个额外的操纵技术产生的深假,包括面值互换和重现. 《第二号协议》评价了该模型普遍采用一套更加多样化的伪造方法的能力。

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 普遍评价

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Cross-Dataset Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 跨数据集评价

blocks.en: W.r.t. Protocol-1, all methods are trained on FF++ and directly evaluated on unseen target datasets to assess cross-dataset generalization. The results are reported in Table 1 in terms of video-level AUC (%). Our results suggest that MoSTE achieves superior average performance across datasets, indicating strong and consistent generalization ability. In particular, MoSTE attains the top performance on DFD and ranks second on CDF-v3 and DFDC, while remaining highly competitive on the other benchmarks. Although ForAda achieves the best results on CDF-v2, DFDC, and DFDCP, our approach demonstrates more balanced performance across datasets.
blocks.zh: W.r.t. Protocol-1, 所有方法都接受关于FF++的培训,并直接在看不见的目标数据集上进行评估,以评估跨数据集的通用性. 表1按视频级别AUC(百分比)报告了结果。 我们的结果表明,科技部在各数据集中取得了较高的平均业绩,表明具有强大和一致的概括能力。 特别是,科技部在DFD上取得了最高业绩,在CDF-v3和DFDC上名列第二,同时在其他基准上保持高度竞争力. 尽管ForAda在CDF-v2,DFDC和DFDCP上取得了最佳成绩,但我们的方法表明,各数据集的性能更加平衡.

blocks.en: Compared with existing SOTA, MoSTE excels on single benchmarks, as well as maintains robust performance under different distribution shifts, i.e., ability to generalize across datasets.
blocks.zh: 与现有的SOTA相比,MOSTE在单一基准上表现优异,并在不同的分布变化下保持强劲的性能,即跨数据集通用的能力.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Cross-Manipulation Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 交叉管理 评价

blocks.en: W.r.t. Protocol-2, where models are trained on FF++ and evaluated on unseen DF40 manipulations, Table 2 directly validates our central claim by evaluating both Face Swap and Face Reenactment attacks. MoSTE achieves the best overall performance and maintains a consistent high AUC across both manipulation families.
blocks.zh: W.r.t. Protocol 2对模型进行了FF++的培训,并对未见的DF40操纵进行了评估,表2通过评价Face Swap和Face Reenactment攻击直接验证了我们的中心主张. 科技部取得了最佳的总体业绩,在两个操纵家庭都保持了一贯的高水平AUC。

blocks.en: Unlike Fig. 1 , which averages over all DF40 methods per family, Table 2 reports per-method results on a representative subset covering distinct generation mechanisms (e.g., latent-space animation in LIA, audio-driven lip synchronization in Wav2Lip, warping-based motion transfer in TPSM). MoSTE performs strongly on Face Swap (BleFace, InSwap, SimSwap, UniFace) while generalizing well to Face Reenactment (Wav2Lip, LIA, TPSM), whereas recent PEFT-based detectors are less balanced across the two families. This indicates that spatio-temporal expert routing reduces manipulation-specific bias and yields more transferable forensic representations.
blocks.zh: 与图1(每个家庭平均使用所有DF40方法)不同的是,表2报告每个方法对一个具有代表性的子集的结果,该子集涵盖不同的生成机制(例如LIA中的潜在空间动画,Wav2Lip中音频驱动的唇同步,TPSM中基于warping的运动转移). MoSTE在Face Swap(BleFace,InSwap,SimSwap,UniFace)上表现强劲,同时将"Face Reenactment"(Wav2Lip,LIA,TPSM)概括,而最近的基于PEFT的探测器在两个家族之间则不太平衡. 这表明,时空专家的路线可减少操纵特有的偏见,并产生更多的可转移的法医陈述。

All methods use official checkpoints and setup settings provided by authors. Metric: video-level AUC (%). Best results are bolded and second-best underlined.
blocks.zh: 表2:根据《议定书》第2条进行的交叉管理评价。 模型在FF++上接受训练,并在CDF-域面互换和重现操纵上进行测试. 所有方法都使用官方检查站和作者提供的设置设置. 计量:视频级AUC (%). 最佳成果是大胆的,是次佳的。

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Robustness Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 强性评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the robustness of our proposed framework against common post-processing perturbations. Following the experimental protocol in [ 22 ] , we subject FF++ test data to six categories of distortions across multiple severity levels, viz. color saturation, color contrast, block-wise distortions, Gaussian blur, JPEG compression, and Gaussian noise. We compare MoSTE with recent SOTA approaches, including ForAda [ 10 ] , UCF [ 56 ] , and the CLIP-based baseline [ 42 ] . As summarized in Fig. 4 , our method consistently outperforms competing approaches in mean performance. Specifically, this disentangled spatio-temporal experts setup maintains forensic fidelity despite compression and noise, demonstrating robustness to common real-world degradations.
blocks.zh: 我们对照处理后的共同干扰,评估我们拟议框架的健全性。 遵循[22]中的实验协议,我们把FF++测试数据按六类扭曲,跨越多个重度级别,即颜色饱和,颜色对比,区块扭曲,高斯模糊,JPEG压缩,高斯噪音. 我们比较了科技部与SOTA最近的做法,包括ForAda[10]、铀转化[56]和基于CLIP的基准[42]。 如图4所示,我们的方法在平均业绩方面一贯优于相互竞争的方法。 具体地说,这个分散的时空专家尽管受到压缩和噪音,但仍保持法医学忠心,显示出对常见现实世界退化的强烈性。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Robustness analysis on FF++. We evaluate the video-level AUC under six common perturbations such as Gaussian Blur and JPEG compression across multiple severity levels. MoSTE exhibits lower performance degradation compared to SOTA.
blocks.zh: 图4:FF++上的强性分析. 我们评价视频级的AUC 在六种常见扰动之下,如高斯蓝和JPEG压缩 跨多个重度级别。 与SOTA相比,MOSTE表现出较低的性能退化.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Main components ablation. Impact of MoE, “S” for Spatial, and “T” for Temporal components. The metric is video-level AUC (%).
blocks.zh: 表3:主要构成部分 教育部、空间部分“S”和临时部分“T”的影响。 衡量标准为视频级AUC(%).

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Ablation on Adapter Components
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 关于适应器部件的规定

blocks.en: We isolate the core components of the MoSTE architecture to validate our design choices, see Table 3 . Replacing the MoE routing mechanism with an unweighted ensemble of 4 experts leads to a notable degradation of generalizability, particularly on DFDCP dataset with a − 2.7 % -2.7\% . This indicates that the concurrent activation of all learned features introduces noise, degrading model performance. Without the specialized focus of the routers, the final representation of each token becomes less informative, preventing the model from isolating the specific spatial or temporal traces it has learned to identify. Furthermore, disabling either the spatial or temporal branch severely degrades performance, demonstrating that both branches are mandatory.
blocks.zh: 我们孤立了MoSTE架构的核心组件,以验证我们的设计选择,见表3。 以4名专家组成的未加权组合取代教育部的路由机制,导致通用性明显退化,特别是在DFDCP数据集中,通用率为-2.7%。 这表明,同时激活所有学习到的特征会引入噪音,降低模型性能. 如果没有路由器的专门重点,每个信物的最终表示就会变得信息较少,使模型无法隔离它所学会识别的特定空间或时间痕迹. 此外,使空间或时间分支丧失功能会严重降低性能,表明这两个分支都是强制性的。

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Ablation on Experts
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 关于专家的建议

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation Study on Expert Configuration. Impact of the total number of experts ( N N ) and the Top- k k routing selection on video-level AUC.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于专家配置的研究。 专家总数(N N)和Top-k k路由选择对视频级AUC的影响.

blocks.en:
Table 4 shows the effect of the number of experts N N and the Top- k k routing threshold. The experiment N = 1 N=1 serves as a baseline; it refers to a simple dense spatio-temporal adapter without any router.
Introducing multiple experts ( N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 ) consistently improves the average AUC over the single path spatio-temporal baseline, confirming the benefit of specialization. Performance increases up to N = 4 N=4 , while further scaling to N = 8 N=8 yields no additional gains and slightly reduces stability across datasets, indicating diminishing returns from excessive capacity.
blocks.zh:
表4显示N N和Top-k k路由阈值专家人数的影响。 实验N = 1 N = 1作为基线;它指的是一个简单的密集的时空适配器,没有任何路由器.
引进多位专家(N ≥2 N\geq 2 )持续改善平均AUC高于单一路径时空基线,证实了专业化的好处。 性能提升至N=4N=4,而进一步缩放至N=8N=8,不产生额外收益,并略微降低各数据集的稳定性,表明产能过剩的回报率下降.

blocks.en: Overall, N = 4 N=4 with Top- k = 3 k=3 achieves the best trade-off between performance and parameter efficiency, delivering the highest average AUC while keeping the parameter increase below 7% (19M params).
blocks.zh: 总体而言,N = 4 N = 4 配Top-k = 3 k = 3 实现性能和参数效率的最佳权衡,提供最高平均AUC,同时将参数增加率保持在7%以下(19M参数).

blocks.en: 4.4.3 One Router Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 一个路由器

blocks.en: Table 5 : One router ablation. Comparison of expert selection methods with only one router. The metric is video-level AUC.
blocks.zh: 表5:一个路由器衰竭。 专家选择方法与只有一个路由器的比较. 衡量标准是视频级AUC.

blocks.en:
A key design element of MoSTE is the use of independent routers for the spatial and temporal expert pools. We evaluate this architecture against two “Unified Routing” baselines to justify the decoupling of forensic traces. In the Pair Selection (PS) configuration, a single router dispatches tokens to a fixed pair consisting of one spatial and one temporal expert. Conversely, the Free Selection (FS) setting employs a single router that is free to route tokens to any available expert, regardless of whether that expert specializes in spatial or temporal features.
Results are reported in Table 5 .
blocks.zh:
科技部的一个关键设计要素是使用独立的路由器进行空间和时间专家人才库。 我们根据两个“统一路线”基线来评估这一结构,以证明法医痕迹的脱钩是合理的。 在Pair选择(PS)配置中,一个单一的路由器向一个由1个空间和1个时间专家组成的固定对发送符. 相反,自由选择(FS)设置使用一个单一的路由器,可以自由向任何可用的专家传递路由符号,无论该专家是否专门研究空间或时间特征。
表5报告了结果。

blocks.en: 4.5 Qualitative Analysis of Expert Specialization
blocks.zh: 4.5 专家专长定性分析

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Spatial Expert
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 空间专家

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Average Attention Maps on CDF-v2. Visualization of the average spatial attention maps from our MoSTE adapter across three network depths (ordered from top to bottom: layers 1, 14, and 23). The heatmaps illustrate the emergent routing behavior of four distinct experts (E0–E3).
blocks.zh: 图5:CDF-v2上的平均关注地图. 通过三个网络深度(从上到下排列:1、14和23层),可视化我们MOSTE适配器的平均空间注意力图。 热图说明了4位不同专家(E0–E3)的突发路由行为.

blocks.en: In Fig. 5 , we visualize the averaged attention maps of four spatial experts from our MoSTE framework on CDF-v2 test samples. We select attention maps from three different backbone depths. The results show that, at each depth, the experts focus on distinct facial regions, such as the forehead, cheeks, and eyebrows, without explicit supervision. These visualizations offer indicative evidence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE captures complementary cues across heterogeneous forgery features in videos.
blocks.zh: 在图5中,我们可视化4位空间专家的平均关注地图,这些地图来自我们关于CDF-v2测试样本的MOSTE框架。 我们从三个不同的主干深处 选择了注意力图 结果显示,在每一深度,专家都专注于不同的面部区域,如额头,脸颊,和眉毛,而没有明确的监督. 这些可视化提供了专家多样性的指示性证据,表明科技部在视频中收集了各种伪造特征之间的互补提示。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Temporal Expert Complementarity
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 临时专家互补

blocks.en: We use linear CKA [ 25 ] to measure whether temporal experts learn redundant or complementary representations. Expert outputs are extracted before spatial fusion, up-projection, and the global residual connection, then weighted by their temporal router assignments while keeping the same ordered spatio-temporal tokens across experts.
blocks.zh: 我们用线性CKA[25]来衡量时间专家是否学习冗余或互补表述. 在空间聚变、向上预测和全球剩余连接之前,先提取专家产出,然后按其时间路由器任务进行加权,同时在专家之间保留同样订购的时空信号。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 6 , off-diagonal CKA values remain low ( 0.15 0.15 – 0.18 0.18 ), while diagonal values are 1.0 1.0 by construction. This suggests that temporal experts avoid representational collapse and learn complementary inter-frame forensic cues.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,对角CKA值仍然较低(0.15 0.15 – 0.18 0.18),对角值则按构造为1.0 1.0。 这表明,时间专家避免了代表性崩溃,学会了互补的跨框架法证提示。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Temporal expert similarity measured with linear CKA. Metric is averaged over all blocks of backbone and 1000 samples from CDF-v2.
blocks.zh: 图6:用线性CKA测量的瞬间专家相似性。 平均测量所有骨干区块和CDF-v2的1000个样本。

blocks.en: 4.6 Capacity-Controlled Adapter Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.6 能力控制的适应器

blocks.en: A natural question is whether MoSTE’s gains stem from expert routing or simply from increased adapter capacity. To isolate this factor, we compare MoSTE against dense dual-pathway spatio-temporal adapters with enlarged bottleneck dimensions, chosen to match or exceed the trainable parameter count of MoSTE. As shown in Table 6 , increasing the capacity of a dense adapter does not consistently improve out-of-distribution generalization. In particular, the 75M-parameter baseline underperforms the smaller 25M baseline on average, suggesting that additional capacity alone may amplify overfitting to the source distribution. In contrast, MoSTE achieves the best average AUC with fewer parameters than the largest dense baseline, indicating that the improvement comes from conditional spatio-temporal expert routing rather than parameter count alone.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是科技部的收益是来自专家的路由,还是仅仅是来自适应器能力的提高。 为了隔离这个因素,我们比较了MoSTE和密集的双路径断层-时空适配器,它们具有扩大的瓶颈维度,被选择与MoSTE匹配或超过可列车参数计数. 如表6所示,增加密集适配器的容量并不能持续改善分配外的通用化. 特别是,75M参数基线的绩效平均低于较小的25M基线,这表明仅仅增加能力就可能扩大与来源分布的不成比例。 相比之下,MOSTE以比最大密度基线更少的参数实现最佳平均值AUC,表明改进来自有条件的时空专家的路由,而不是仅参数计数.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Capacity-controlled comparison with dense dual-pathway adapters.
blocks.zh: 表6:与密集双路适配器的能力控制比较。

blocks.en: 4.7 Effect of Scaling
blocks.zh: 4.7 放大的效果

blocks.en: To evaluate scalability, we follow recent large-scale training protocols based on DF40 [ 55 ] . Our model ( N = 4 N=4 , Top- k = 3 k=3 ) is trained on a DF40 subset containing over 25,000 video sequences spanning 23 distinct Face Swap and Reenactment methods. We ensure no overlap with other evaluation datasets. For comparison, we retrain EFFORT, a strong PEFT baseline, using the authors’ official implementation, increasing the residual rank to handle greater manipulation diversity. We also report results from DF40 project checkpoints for CLIP full fine-tuning [ 42 ] and an I3D-based [ 4 ] video detector.
blocks.zh: 为了评估可扩展性,我们遵循基于DF40[55]的近期大规模训练协议. 我们的模型(N = 4 N = 4,Top-k = 3 k = 3)是在DF40子集上训练的,包含超过25,000个视频序列,跨越23个不同的Face交换和重现方法. 我们确保不与其他评价数据集重叠。 作为比较,我们利用作者的正式执行,重新训练EFFORT这个强有力的PEFT基线,增加剩余级别,以处理更大的操纵多样性。 我们还报告DF40项目检查站对CLIP进行全面微调[42]和一个基于I3D的[4]视频探测器的结果。

blocks.en: Evaluation is performed on four benchmarks, including FF++, DFD, CDF-v2, and FaceShifter. Table 7 indicates that MoSTE benefits from large-scale and diverse training, while maintaining consistent generalization performance across unseen manipulations compared to SOTA.
blocks.zh: 评价按四个基准进行,包括FF++、DFD、CDF-v2和FaceShifter。 表7显示,科技部受益于大规模和多样化的培训,同时保持了与SOTA相比,在无形的操纵中一致的通用性。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Video-level AUC (%) of different deepfake detection methods trained on DF40 [ 55 ] . † \dagger denotes models evaluated from the released DF40 checkpoints, while FR+FS indicates training on a combination of Face Swap and Face Reenactment sequences.
blocks.zh: 表7:在DF40[55]上接受过不同深假检测方法的视频级AUC(%).\dagger表示从解禁的DF40检查站评价的模型,而FR+FS则表示FaceSwap和Face Reenactment序列组合的培训.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced MoSTE, a novel Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts framework designed to improve generalization in video deepfake detection. Different manipulation types produce fundamentally different spatial and temporal artifacts, rendering a single adaptation pathway inherently biased toward particular forgery families, i.e., face swap and face reenactment.
To overcome this limitation, MoSTE decouples feature representation into parallel spatial and temporal experts. Specifically, we learn a set of specialized experts and dynamically select which experts process each token. This enables the model to adapt to heterogeneous forgery patterns while remaining fully label-free and end-to-end trainable.
In our extensive evaluations we showcase that our single-stage approach successfully balances detection capabilities across diverse manipulation methods. By establishing new state-of-the-art performance on both, cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks, alongside proven robustness to real-world video perturbations, MoSTE provides a highly adaptable detection approach in the continuously evolving landscape of video forgeries.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了MoSTE,一个小说Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Expertion 框架,旨在改进视频深假检测的概括性. 不同的操纵类型产生完全不同的空间和时间文物,使单一的适应路径在本质上偏向于特定的伪造家庭,即面相交换和面相再现。
为了克服这一限制,科技部脱钩方案将代表性表现为平行的空间和时间专家。 具体地说,我们学习了一组专门专家,并动态地选择哪些专家处理每个符号。 这使得该模型能够适应不同的伪造模式,同时保持完全无标签和端到端可训练。
在我们的广泛评价中,我们展示了我们的单阶段方法成功地平衡了各种操纵方法的探测能力。 通过在跨数据集和跨操纵基准上建立新的先进性能,以及证明对真实世界视频扰动的强性,科技部在不断演变的视频假冒景观中提供了一个高度适应性的检测方法。
